q: draft a PR description for splitting out the billing service
reply: 好的 dan the builder，根据之前的对话，我看到你一直在做 billing migration 相关的工作，但没有找到之前关于拆分 billing service 的具体讨论。我基于你的项目背景和之前的 PR 规范来起草一个草稿：

**Title**: Split billing service into standalone module

**Description**:
- Extract billing logic from monolith into its own service, including payment processing, subscription management, and invoice generation
- New service uses the same database schema and migration path established in the billing migration dry run
- API endpoints remain backward-compatible; all existing consumers (webhook handler, frontend) updated to point to new service URL
- CI pipeline extended to run tests for billing service independently
- Rollback plan: keep old billing code in monolith behind a feature flag; can switch back by toggling flag and reverting URL changes

**Risk**: medium. Service split touches API routing, database connections, and deploy order. Rollback via feature flag tested in staging. Coordinate deploy with Tom's webhook refactor v2 to avoid merge conflicts.
